market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $70,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78.3k May 2; needs Low <=$70k in May, ~10.5% drawdown. Last week of April BTC was as low as ~$76.3k (May 1 open). One-month moves of 10% downside happen but require fading momentum or risk-off catalyst. Implied vol on Bitcoin suggests roughly 25-35% chance of touching $70k in May.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether $80k resistance triggers a deeper retrace toward $70k.
